MAPA-01.note: Each kept distractor is still refuted explicitly by the adapted passage: she could not pay me (money for school), school was out with no homework (assignment), loved it too much to want it sold (selling). The dropped 'broke something' option goes along with the cut 'no pane of mine' clause, so the two still match.

MAPA-02.note: 'Receipt or no receipt, story or no story' keeps both proof-based distractors (customer's word, no money without proof) wrong, and 'we had not even grown that fig' still kills the grown-plant option. The cut 'not teaching anybody a lesson' only refuted the dropped option.

MAPA-03.note: The source's explicit denials are replaced by evidence: she 'did not smile once', she 'could see why' her aunt acted, and her aunt 'had been right'. Those rule out amusement, confusion and disapproval. 'Face went hot' supports shame. Admiration was dropped along with its denial, so no undenied admiration reading is left behind.

MAPA-04.note: Same sense of 'ran' (extend in a line). The paragraph-1 reference is correct, and the distractors are the same other senses reworded. 'Spread over a surface' is as weak a distractor as it was in the source.

MAPA-05.note: Gift, trade and distrust-of-hull distractors still map to the club, Petrus and knife-test details, which the passage still refutes (no rot). The dropped 'licensed again' option goes along with the cut registry and island-crossing sentences.

MAPA-06.note: The key is the same. 'Could no longer trust' replaces 'vouch for' with the same role, and the dropped island-crossing option matches the cut islanders sentence.

MAPA-07.note: The source's denials of relief and pride are replaced by behavior: she walked away from the 'brave thing' remark and kept arguing at dinner. Those still rule out pride and 'argument is over', and a tight jaw rules out amusement. The dropped 'unease about winter' goes along with the cut 'no crossing to dread' line.

MAPA-08.note: Same sense of 'drew' (attracted in numbers). 'Needed as a depth of water' spells out the source's 'required as depth' (a boat's draft) without changing its role. The paragraph-4 reference is correct.

MAPA-09.note: 'Never gave her credit' means the same as 'credited her nowhere'. The self-print, library and newspaper distractors are each still refuted in paragraph 2, and the dropped 'printed abroad' option goes along with the cut foreign-publisher sentence.

MAPA-10.note: Adapted paragraph 3 corresponds to source paragraph 2, and the reference is correct. The written-records, schoolchildren and other-village distractors keep their roles, and the dropped 'twice-heard' option goes along with the cut 'first time a seller said it' sentence.

MAPA-11.note: The key belief is stated almost word for word. The 'children write the dialect before school corrects them' distractor is weakly inferable from the corrected-letter line, but it was equally so in the source, so the adaptation did not create this.

MAPA-12.note: 'A set amount' is the same sense as 'a fixed quantity' for 'a measure of oil'. The judgment, law and step distractors are kept, 'outward sign' is dropped, and the paragraph-3 reference is correct.

MAPA-13.note: The options are identical. The publisher's refusal plus the removal of the cliffhangers once parts no longer had to sell still point to obligation over design, habit or chance. The cut 'different terms' sentence was extra support for this, not essential to it.

MAPA-14.note: The options are identical, and the 'fooled by a good kicker' vs 'failed to move' contrast still makes blame the answer. The source's self-attribution by keepers became 'people say', which still describes blame.

MAPA-15.note: Noise is kept, and the added 'though' strengthens the contrast with 'a tool'. 'A rarity' for 'an anomaly' and 'a breakdown' for 'a malfunction' are close enough in role, since both are still contradicted by a steady, worldwide, wave-made hum. 'Rarity' is slightly easier to reject than 'anomaly'.

MAPA-16.note: Rising is kept, since Parliament raised the toll every time. 'Uncontrolled' replaces 'discretionary' and is still refuted because the toll 'stayed where the law put it', though it shifts slightly from 'set at the company's will' to 'unregulated'. Unequal and hidden are unchanged.

MAPA-17.note: The options are identical, and the light-trap moths vs lamp-ignoring moths contrast is kept, so 'On the other hand' is the only fit.

MAPA-18.note: The options are identical, and the cause (wet, packed pine crust) followed by the effect (more ice lost) is kept. 'By comparison' was as tempting in the source as it is here.

MAPA-19.note: The options are identical. The chevron-and-bar mark is still one specific case of tracing single workers, so 'For instance' is the fit.

MAPA-20.note: The options are identical. The rods sit in water until spring while dried stock is sorted, so 'Meanwhile' is still the only fit.

MAPA-21.note: Same key proposition (outer birds driven back). The distractors keep their roles: shared warmth supports the old mutual-benefit view, equal predation undercuts the shielding claim, and more chicks per colony is general cooperation.

MAPA-22.note: Same key: expecting to teach helps recall with no actual teaching ('but no one taught' is a little clipped but means the same). The confound (actual teaching), enjoyment and delay distractors are kept.

MAPA-23.note: Same key: weak institutions before oil, still slow after it ran out. The curse-supporting, irrelevant-diversification and argument-weakening distractors are each kept.

MAPA-24.note: Same key: no extra predation or exhaustion cost, so nothing punishes the trait. The female-preference, related-species decline and learning distractors are kept, and the added 'every time' does not change the role of the first one.
